comparison.objective: Turn off a named rotary isolator and padlock its handle at OFF, versus commission and secure a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Selector rotation and padlock manipulation; candidate requires tool insertion, setscrew release, controlled collar adjustment, counterholding, and witness-torque testing.
comparison.success_condition: Named isolator remains locked at OFF. Candidate instead passes on two bounded dynamic cycles with no drift, rebound, overload, or hard-stop contact.
comparison.reason: Rotary lockout establishes an electrical safety state, whereas the candidate tunes a mechanical response and validates it dynamically.
